title: Japan's Nikkei average briefly regains 70,000 mark as AI optimism returns
source_used: Nikkei Asia (opening paragraph) and Retail News Asia
key_facts: Nikkei Stock Average crossed 70,000 intraday on Monday 5 Oct 2026, the first time in three months
Technology shares led the rise on renewed AI optimism
September US jobs report showed slower-than-expected growth
Investors pared back bets on a Fed rate hike this month
Tokyo had traded below 70,000 for three months
quote_evidence: TOKYO -- Japanese stocks jumped on Monday, with the benchmark Nikkei Stock Average crossing the 70,000 threshold during intraday trading for the first time in three months.
why_it_matters_hint: Rate-hike fears eased and AI-linked shares led.
notes: Nikkei Asia text available only as its opening paragraph; the rest was read in a Retail News Asia write-up of the same story (https://www.retailnews.asia/tokyo-stocks-breach-70000-as-tech-gains-drive-nikkei-rally), which is an aggregator-style piece with its own commentary that was not used. Another outlet (biggo) reported the index "struggles near 69,700" after profit-taking later that day.
